critical_code_review_comments: GuidedPracticeOverlay: If steps array is empty (parseStepsFromPractice returns []), the overlay returns null - no rendering. The buildPractice() function in CreativeProcesses.jsx handles this by always providing fallback steps, so it's safe in practice.
All is working correctly - no critical code issues found.

Elemental Temples depth additions verified: all 5 temples (Earth/Water/Fire/Air/Spirit) have Why It Heals as first active tab showing scientific/philosophical content, plus Ancient Traditions tab with cross-cultural history. All original tabs (Embodiment, Within You, In Nature, Practices, Rituals, Ceremonies, Blessings, Affirmations, Safety) still working. 12 creative process cards available. Category filters work. Timer shows correct duration from API data.
rca_of_the_issue: Creative blank screen bug: was caused by inline PracticeTimer used inside modal without proper overlay wrapper. Fixed by replacing with GuidedPracticeOverlay component that renders as full-screen fixed overlay via AnimatePresence, ensuring it never shows a blank/empty screen.
